demonstrates:
with 4000 deadlines spread across 200 cases in one organisation and ANALYZE run, the planner chose deadlines_case_open_idx for a selective open-by-case read and deadlines_org_open_idx for the organisation-wide upcoming read. The counter-case is recorded too: a single case holding roughly a third of the table is read by sequential scan, which is the planner being correct rather than the index being unused. No timing claim is made. Plans:
{
  "open_by_case": "Sort  (cost=58.41..58.45 rows=17 width=32)
  Sort Key: deadline_at, created_at, id
  ->  Bitmap Heap Scan on deadlines d  (cost=4.41..58.06 rows=17 width=32)
        Recheck Cond: ((case_id = 'eefd5c42-9fda-4967-938b-98d8c553a24b'::uuid) AND (status = 'open'::text))
        Filter: (organisation_id = '13aa25ac-590b-4dc1-8dda-8130eff32200'::uuid)
        ->  Bitmap Index Scan on deadlines_case_open_idx  (cost=0.00..4.41 rows=17 width=0)
              Index Cond: (case_id = 'eefd5c42-9fda-4967-938b-98d8c553a24b'::uuid)",
  "open_by_case_dominant": "Sort  (cost=553.52..562.31 rows=3517 width=32)
  Sort Key: deadline_at, created_at, id
  ->  Seq Scan on deadlines d  (cost=0.00..346.37 rows=3517 width=32)
        Filter: ((case_id = 'b1f10aaf-bf38-4e74-9837-cda0eae54f40'::uuid) AND (organisation_id = '13aa25ac-590b-4dc1-8dda-8130eff32200'::uuid) AND (status = 'open'::text))",
  "upcoming_by_org": "Limit  (cost=0.67..8.62 rows=50 width=32)
  ->  Incremental Sort  (cost=0.67..1104.58 rows=6948 width=32)
        Sort Key: d.deadline_at, d.created_at, d.id
        Presorted Key: d.deadline_at
        ->  Nested Loop  (cost=0.44..896.43 rows=6948 width=32)
              ->  Index Scan using deadlines_org_open_idx on deadlines d  (cost=0.28..687.62 rows=7017 width=48)
                    Index Cond: (organisation_id = '13aa25ac-590b-4dc1-8dda-8130eff32200'::uuid)
              ->  Memoize  (cost=0.15..0.18 rows=1 width=16)
                    Cache Key: d.case_id
                    Cache Mode: logical
                    ->  Index Scan using cases_pkey on cases c  (cost=0.14..0.17 rows=1 width=16)
                          Index Cond: (id = d.case_id)
                          Filter: (workspace_id = ANY ('{1d6ec13c-958e-44cf-9768-7f54ee402249}'::uuid[]))"
}
